body:
Corrected a stale status: WOTAN-DNS-001's deploy already happened
(wotan.okemily.com is live) -- live-verified the full read path (register,
catalog, character resolution) end to end against the running iduna.service.

Shipped Phase 4.5's real gap: POST /api/v1/characters/:id/hats/generated
(agent-only) creates a brand-new hats row and grants it to a character in
one transaction -- the missing piece for the "surprise box" design
(spend Flow now, generate later at use time). 2 new tests, go build/vet/test
./... clean, live-verified end to end with a real DRAGONSNSHIT-MUD agent
token.

Also resolved Phase 3's design (founder real-time): BRAWLPIT's hat-selection
screen offers 3 free hats (Blue/Red/Green) with no login required, plus an
optional login surfacing real store-unlocked hats. Not yet built -- native
SDL2/network client work scoped as its own follow-up.

Commits: IDUNA 9e56e2b, BRAWLPIT 0ba457a.

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN hat store: Phase 2 verified live + Phase 4.5 generate-endpoint shipped
